AboutUs.impact_description: The Local Action Group Oak of the Dacians actively contributes to the development of rural communities in the Cimișlia-Căușeni districts by supporting local initiatives. Through the projects we back, we contribute to the economic, social, and cultural development of villages, the valorization of resources, and cooperation between communities. We aim for more prosperous, well-connected, and forward-looking villages—through active involvement, innovative ideas, and the efficient use of resources for the benefit of the people.
AboutUs.main_headline: LAG “Oak of the Dacians” is a local association in the Cimișlia and Căușeni districts that supports sustainable rural development.

News.title: Stay informed and follow our activity on and beyond the territory.
News.visualization_header: News about projects, events, carried out actions, and more
News.visualization_text: Here we publish the most important news and updates from the activity of LAG “Oak of the Dacians”: open calls, local events, trainings, collaborations, civic initiatives, and promotion of successes in the territory. Stay informed and involved in everything that matters in our region!

Projects.title: Projects that turn ideas into reality and inspire an entire community.
Projects.visualization_header: Initiatives that bring change to rural communities
Projects.visualization_text: Each project contributes to a more sustainable, equitable, and active rural environment. Projects supported by the LAG respond concretely to local needs: modernization of public institutions, support for entrepreneurs, environmental protection, cultural activities, and youth engagement.

AuthenticLocal.title: Discover the authenticity of the region through local products, attractions, people, and community services.
AuthenticLocal.visualization_header: Discover the richness of our communities
AuthenticLocal.visualization_text: Behind each village in our region lie stories, people, traditions, and initiatives that give meaning and value to everyday life. This section is dedicated to promoting authentic local resources—from carefully crafted household products to services offered by small entrepreneurs, must-see places, and people who keep the community spirit alive.

LocalProducts.title: Discover local products with history, taste, and soul from our region.
LocalProducts.visualization_text: Here you will find products crafted with care, passion, and skill by artisans, producers, and entrepreneurs from the villages that are members of LAG “Oak of the Dacians.” Whether handcrafted items, traditional preserves, artisanal products, or folk art pieces, each good tells a local story, carries identity, and supports a vibrant and sustainable rural economy. We promote what is authentic, high-quality, born from local tradition and innovation.

Services.title: Local resources and services that support regional development.
Services.visualization_header: What our villages offer: from taste to experience
Services.visualization_text: Beyond picturesque landscapes and authentic hospitality, LAG localities hide a diverse network of services and activities that contribute to quality of life and sustainable development. We invite you to discover concrete examples of local services—from craft workshops and educational centers to agro-guesthouses, tourist activities, social initiatives, or small-scale artisanal production.

PeopleAndValues.title: People who inspire through deeds, values, and local involvement.
PeopleAndValues.visualization_header: People who build the future of the community through actions
PeopleAndValues.visualization_text: Here we present people who inspire by example. Each of them contributes, through their work and vocation, to the development of a living, dignified community connected to the values that unite us: solidarity, respect for tradition, and the courage to make positive changes.

TouristAttractions.title: Discover the representative places of the region—tradition, nature, and heritage.
TouristAttractions.visualization_text: This section presents the places and experiences that define the identity of the region, from natural attractions and heritage monuments to festivals, local cuisine, and family-run tourist initiatives. Rural tourism comes to life through the people and places that keep the authentic village spirit alive.

listAndStatistics.description: The Local Action Group “Oak of the Dacians” is a local association registered on November 23, 2023, bringing together actors from the public, civic, and entrepreneurial sectors. The LAG promotes sustainable rural development in its coverage area based on its own Local Development Strategy, elaborated participatorily and adapted to the needs of member communities.
